projects.title: Ciputra Resort Askana
projects.summary: Contemporary coastal villa photography capturing clean lines, functional spaces, and seaside resort living in Tabanan.
projects.description: Contemporary coastal villa photography capturing clean lines, functional spaces, and seaside resort living in Tabanan.
projects.content:
## Overview

Architectural and interior documentation of Type Askana, situated in the seaside Resvara cluster at Ciputra Beach Resort in Tabanan, Bali. The photography captures the modern two-story villa's compact 76 m² architecture, emphasizing efficient spatial design, contemporary vacation comfort, and harmonious integration into the coastal landscape.

## Concept & Lighting

Highlighting linear structural geometry, tall vertical window apertures, and clean spatial flow from the living lounge into private master suites. Bright daylight balanced with gentle shadow gradations brings out natural wood textures, clean architectural lines, and neutral tones, evoking an understated and relaxed seaside aesthetic.

projects.title: The Huthut
projects.summary: Editorial villa photography capturing tropical architecture, pool living, natural textures, and serene outdoor spaces in bright, relaxed daylight.
projects.description: Editorial villa photography capturing tropical architecture, pool living, natural textures, and serene outdoor spaces in bright, relaxed daylight.
projects.content:
## Overview

A boutique hospitality and property photography assignment documenting The Hut Hut, a secluded retreat nestled in Bingin, Uluwatu. The visual series captures the intimate cluster of six handcrafted wooden bungalows, the central turquoise swimming pool, open-air communal living spaces, and tranquil garden pathways tailored for peaceful coastal stays.

## Concept & Lighting

Highlighting the organic geometry of sustainable bamboo joinery, high-vaulted thatched ceilings, and fluid transitions between private suites and tropical outdoor living. Soft ambient daylight filtering through the surrounding canopy illuminates warm weathered teak surfaces, while low-angle morning sun accentuates tactile craftsmanship and serene island living.

projects.title: Ciputra Resort Svana
projects.summary: Architectural photography capturing a luxury two-story residence in the Resvara coastal cluster at Ciputra Beach Resort.
projects.description: Architectural photography capturing a luxury two-story residence in the Resvara coastal cluster at Ciputra Beach Resort.
projects.content:
## Overview

An architectural photography commission documenting Type Svana within the coastal Resvara cluster at Ciputra Beach Resort in Tabanan, Bali. The assignment captures the spacious two-story luxury residence, highlighting its expansive 125 m² layout, functional spatial zoning, and seamless connection between interior open-plan living and lush private garden grounds near the sunset beach.

## Concept & Lighting

Highlighting clean orthogonal sightlines, double-height ceiling volumes, and the tranquil interplay between natural illumination and tropical landscaping. Natural afternoon daylight was utilized to accent raw stone textures, refined timber cabinetry, and smooth neutral plaster finishes, establishing an airy and sophisticated coastal ambiance.

projects.title: Sola
projects.summary: Editorial hotel photography capturing tropical architecture, warm interiors, refined material details, and relaxed outdoor spaces. A cohesive visual story highlighting the property's design, atmosphere, and overall guest experience.
projects.description: Editorial hotel photography capturing tropical architecture, warm interiors, refined material details, and relaxed outdoor spaces. A cohesive visual story highlighting the property's design, atmosphere, and overall guest experience.
projects.content:
## Overview

An architectural and hospitality photography assignment documenting Sola, an intimate boutique retreat in Pecatu, Uluwatu. The series presents a cohesive visual narrative of the property, capturing its central swimming pool, minimalist guest suites, architectural daybeds, and relaxed open-air dining atmosphere near Bali's southern coast.

## Concept & Lighting

Highlighting Mediterranean-inspired arches, clean brutalist geometry, and warm tactile finishes under ambient daylight. Natural tropical sunlight was composed to cast striking geometric shadows along cantilevered corridors during the day, softening into a warm golden glow across textured linen, limestone, and timber details at dusk.

projects.title: White Penny
projects.summary: Editorial boutique property photography capturing bohemian-chic suites, lagoon pool living, lush tropical gardens, and relaxed poolside dining.
projects.description: Editorial boutique property photography capturing bohemian-chic suites, lagoon pool living, lush tropical gardens, and relaxed poolside dining.
projects.content:
## Overview

An editorial hospitality photography commission capturing White Penny, a boutique lifestyle destination and social hub on Jalan Pura Telaga Waja in Petitenget, Seminyak. The coverage showcases the property's vibrant island aesthetic across its curving lagoon swimming pool, bohemian-chic private guest suites, lush tropical gardens, and the lively White Penny Kitchen & Bar.

## Concept & Lighting

Highlighting textural contrast between rustic macrame accents, warm distressed teak woodwork, and crisp white Mediterranean-inspired facades. Luminous natural daylight was harnessed to enhance turquoise water reflections across the pool deck, while soft interior accent lighting illuminates cozy guest corners and artisanal craftsmanship.

projects.title: Bali Paradise Suites
projects.summary: Editorial private villa photography capturing intimate poolside living, tropical greenery, clean interiors, and relaxed kitchen and lounge spaces.
projects.description: Editorial private villa photography capturing intimate poolside living, tropical greenery, clean interiors, and relaxed kitchen and lounge spaces.
projects.content:
## Overview

Property and hospitality visual documentation for Bali Paradise Suites, located on Jalan Eka Laweya in the Nakula area of Seminyak. The photography assignment highlights each suite as a private tropical sanctuary, capturing intimate plunge pools, sun-drenched timber decking, full-height glass openings, and relaxed open-plan living spaces.

## Concept & Lighting

Highlighting clean linear symmetry, private courtyard geometries, and deep ambient reflections across still plunge pool waters. High-key natural morning daylight was balanced with subtle interior shadows to accentuate polished terrazzo floors, woven textiles, and lush perimeter garden landscaping without artificial glare.

projects.title: Gracie Efata House
projects.summary: Property photography showcasing clean studio living, private balconies, and tranquil residential comfort in Jimbaran.
projects.description: Property photography showcasing clean studio living, private balconies, and tranquil residential comfort in Jimbaran.
projects.content:
## Overview

An architectural and accommodation photography assignment capturing Gracie Efata House on Jalan Ampel Gading in the scenic hills of Jimbaran. The visual coverage presents the property's clean studio units, private terraces, peaceful garden surroundings, and welcoming residential character designed for comfortable short and extended Bali getaways.

## Concept & Lighting

Highlighting practical spatial proportions, uncluttered interior geometry, and seamless visual flow from studio interiors to open-air balconies. Soft directional daylight was utilized to illuminate neutral floor tiles, clean timber joinery, and well-lit living spaces, conveying an inviting and serene home-like ambiance.

projects.title: Xcite Gym
projects.summary: Commercial architectural photography capturing premium fitness spaces, modern training equipment, and athletic interiors in Denpasar.
projects.description: Commercial architectural photography capturing premium fitness spaces, modern training equipment, and athletic interiors in Denpasar.
projects.content:
## Overview

Commercial interior and architectural photography documenting Xcite Gym & Society, located within the prestigious Bali International Golf complex in East Denpasar. The assignment captures the comprehensive athletic training facility, detailing its open weightlifting zones, high-performance strength machinery, cardio sections, and refined club amenities.

## Concept & Lighting

Highlighting bold industrial lines, spacious workout corridors, and high-contrast ambient illumination across heavy training equipment. Directional overhead lighting was balanced against matte impact flooring, textured dark wall accents, and wide wall mirrors to create an energetic, focused, and premium athletic aesthetic.
